description: Source code for analyzing memory usage of CordRep data structures in the Abseil library, including functions for estimating total and fair share memory usage of CordRep objects.

classes.name: CordRepRef
classes.description: Template struct holding a reference to a CordRep and, in kFairShare mode, a fractional weight representing inverse refcount.

classes.name: RawUsage
classes.description: Template struct accumulating total memory usage, with specializations for fair share mode.

methods.name: AnalyzeDataEdge
methods.description: Analyzes memory usage of data edges in CordRep structures.

methods.name: AnalyzeRing
methods.description: Analyzes memory usage of ring-based CordRep structures.

methods.name: AnalyzeBtree
methods.description: Analyzes memory usage of btree-based CordRep structures.

methods.name: GetEstimatedUsage
methods.description: Calculates estimated memory usage of a CordRep, considering different internal representations.

methods.name: GetEstimatedMemoryUsage
methods.description: Public function to estimate total memory usage of a CordRep.

methods.name: GetEstimatedFairShareMemoryUsage
methods.description: Public function to estimate fair share memory usage of a CordRep.
